correctness.rationale: The final statement counts actual functions in reflexive ancestor order, with labelled target middle worlds. An upward image cone test gives one map at a leaf; a middle root permits the same middle or top at every child independently, while the bottom root requires both middle images below. Inclusion–exclusion and the unique top-root map give 2 plus the child product. For the all-order maximum, the envelope with weights 1,3,5 for sizes 1,2,3 is supermultiplicative by concatenation. Replacing pairs 1+1, 1+2, 1+3 and 3+3 proves its best partitions uniquely use twos and at most one three except for size one. Induction gives N≤F(n) and strictly so at n≥4 by the two explicit positive parity differences. At n=1,2 there is one shape; the size-three envelope is attained only by the end-rooted chain. At any root attaining 2+F(n−1), all child counts and the child partition must be jointly optimal, so no child has order ≥4 and the partition forces the stated unique shape. The witness realizes every term of the formula, including both small exceptional orders.
residual_risks: Frozen output is recorded evidence only. Its script verifies extrema by recurrence through order ten, directly counts maps with order-preserving pruning through seven, and verifies witness counts through forty. It asserts maximizer uniqueness, not a separate minimum-uniqueness assertion. The unrestricted proof establishes the quantifiers independently.

value.rationale: The supported problem measures how strongly branching shape affects the count of frame morphisms at a fixed source size. Existence of onto maps is not enough to estimate this count. The exact maximum explains the short-chain mechanism and its parity correction, gives the growth base, and identifies the only saturating source, supplying a precise benchmark for more general fan and source-shape questions.
residual_risks: No generalization to other targets, unrooted classes or onto-only maxima is claimed. The elementary minimum and recursion are not the basis of the value decision.
